title: Sharp dimension threshold for unique FKPP steady states and BBM recurrence
summary: We consider the existence and uniqueness of positive, bounded stationary solutions of the Fisher-KPP equation with Dirichlet boundary conditions. We establish that stationary solutions are unique, and exist if and only if the generalised principal eigenvalue is strictly positive (supercriticality), in dimension at most $6$. This is sharp: we exhibit examples both of non-uniqueness and of existence at criticality in dimension $7$ or higher, including for the classical reaction $f(u)=u-u^2$.
